feature: Server-side enforcement of character encoding constraints during cluster bootstrap and runtime
User schemas should be discoverable via pg_namespace heap rows during PG-standby replication, matching PostgreSQL's schema visibility model.
Schema definitions should be queryable via pg_namespace heap rows and indexes (2684/2685), enabling PostgreSQL standby replication to resolve schemas.
MVCC/HOT-chain corruption verification in verify_heapam (004) - not faithfully portable due to on-disk varatt_external layout divergence
pg_subtrans truncation (cleanup of subtransaction ancestry records) is deferred.
Index column ordering (ASC/DESC/NULLS FIRST/NULLS LAST) is not persisted to disk; ordering is lost across server restart despite faithful dumps within a session
resume_point: Persist indoption bits to on-disk pg_index heap to enable cross-restart index ordering preservation

feature: RECURSIVE and MATERIALIZED views do not capture RawDef and cannot be dumped or restored
resume_point: Implement RawDef capture and storage for RECURSIVE and MATERIALIZED view types

feature: Per-function SET configuration parameters are not tracked; all functions report NULL for the proconfig column.
Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) for MultiXact operations, enabling creation, modification, and deletion of MultiXact records to be logged and recovered after crashes.
Domain CHECK predicates still use legacy wrap instead of new fully-parenthesizing renderer.
Database-level ACL projection (datacl) is not yet implemented.
User-defined function-based casts (WITH FUNCTION casts) are parsed but not dumped in pg_dump; only built-in binary-coercible casts are reachable.
